column1: # Minecraft call sites with no equivalent through renaming.

org/lwjgl/opengl/ARBShaderObjects
# Client brand (F3, MC|Brand packet, crash report): SteinLoader instead of vanilla.
net/minecraft/client/ClientBrandRetriever
# The crash report reads the graphics card name on the thread that crashed; with no GL context there, LWJGL 3 aborts the JVM.
org/lwjgl/opengl/GL11
# Server resource packs (core/ServerPacks): level:// only under saves/<world>/resources.zip (NetHandlerPlayClient.handleResourcePack),
# the pack cache only for packs this account has used (ResourcePackRepository.downloadResourcePack) and no download to a
# local address (HttpUtil's download task), so a server cannot probe the player's files, link accounts or reach the local network.
java/lang/String
java/io/File
java/net/URL
# Item edges (engine/ItemEdges): ItemModelGenerator.isTransparent also takes nearly transparent pixels (alpha up to 16) as
# empty, as the clients resource packs are made on do; otherwise an item painted on an alpha-1 background comes out flat.
bgp
# ClassInheritanceMultiMap (engine/ClassMapGuard): its class list is one static HashSet that the client thread walks
# (a new chunk) while the integrated server adds to it; the walk threw ConcurrentModificationException and the chunk
# packet was lost (a hole in the world). The additions take the set's lock and the walk goes over a copy.
java/util/Set
java/util/Set
